finding: All modules, racking, and combiner in good order
action_taken: Visual inspection, torque check on 10% of clamps

reported_issue: Customer reports output down all week, suspects bad panels
finding: No fault found. Panels test within spec. Low output matches overcast week
String S2 fuse open in combiner box; string at open circuit
action_taken: Replaced 15 A string fuse and fuse holder, verified string current
root_cause: blown string fuse, fuse holder heat discoloration

finding: Hub power supply breaker had tripped; reset. Hub back online

reported_issue: Array output very low since the weekend
finding: No fault found. About 19 in of lake effect snow Dec 7 to 9, panels buried
action_taken: None, advised customer to wait for melt

reported_issue: Customer noticed one panel icon flickering to zero on monitoring portal
finding: Loose MC4 connector on P22 junction box lead, light arcing marks

reported_issue: Whole array near zero since the storm
finding: No fault found. About 30 in on the ground after the storm, all rows buried, sky clear

reported_issue: Still low a week after storm, row 3 worst
finding: No fault found. Rows 1 and 2 partly shed, row 3 drifted against parapet
Same connector loose again. Connector halves are from two different manufacturers (cross mated)
action_taken: Reseated connector, zip tie strain relief. Matched pair ordered

reported_issue: Production low, row 3 worse than others
finding: No fault found. Residual snow on rows after Mar 1 to 2 snowfall

reported_issue: Hub H09 humidity reading stuck at 100%
finding: Condensation inside H09 sensor housing, gasket not seated
action_taken: Dried housing and reseated gasket. Sensor not replaced. Reading still 100% on departure

reported_issue: Low morning output alerts on P34
finding: No fault found. Panel output normal at time of visit (dry, sunny midday)

reported_issue: P22 intermittent zero output, third time
finding: Connector loose with corrosion on contacts. Replaced panel side connector only; matched pair not on truck
Hub back online on arrival, carrier outage in the area
Light soiling rows 1 and 2, heavier dirt line on bottom edge of row 3. No visible module defects on any panel

reported_issue: Output dropped a lot this week
finding: No fault found. Five straight days of overcast and rain

reported_issue: Output down about 10% in the afternoons
finding: No fault found. Heat wave, module temps 60 to 70 C. Normal temperature derate

reported_issue: Array production down several percent over the summer
finding: No fault found. Dry spell soiling, dust film on all rows
action_taken: Recommended cleaning; customer declined with rain in forecast
